scope: Six-format viewer loader/preload navigation with explicit linear-sRGB CLI policy
formats: compressed ASTC HDR explicit linear sRGB

checks.foreground_hit_under_full_managed_pressu: same backing pixel lease, no decode
checks.stale_generation: refused with unchanged root use and cache count
checks.SDR_and_HDR_visible_readbacks: exact against separately loaded same-source references at every step

limitations: Calls actual foreground/preload helpers synchronously; does not qualify asynchronous worker scheduling
Same-source pre/post GPU references are preservation evidence, not independent color-rendering oracle
Memory pressure is managed reservation pressure, not OS-wide pressure
No disk swap in this navigation test; per-format TTL/swap has separate evidence
